text:
ITEM 1 | Pinkish-brown seared meat pieces with a pink, juicy-looking interior and browned crust, cut into irregular chunks about 4-5 cm long and 2-3 cm thick, with small flecks of seasoning/grain-like bits clinging to the surface; sits on the left-center of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Browned meat pieces with a darker crust and lighter pink-gray center, irregular cut chunks about 3-4 cm across and 2 cm thick, speckled with small tan crumbs and flecks, positioned center-right of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Small dark green floret piece (broccoli-like), about 2 cm across, bright green with slightly darker tips, sitting between meat pieces | 8
ITEM 4 | Tan, granular crumbs and bits scattered across the plate, matte and dry, about 1 cm each, clustered near the meat and at the upper right edge | 6
ITEM 5 | Thin reddish-purple stems or stalks, about 3-4 cm long and under 0.5 cm thick, lying across the bottom of the meat pieces | 3
